rule_or_requirement: Preserve valid completion while recovering faster driving from learned pixel gas control.
observable_information: Rendered pixels, inherited stable pixel-driver action and learned three-class posterior at inference; matched TRAIN diagnostic telemetry during evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Veto learned boost when inherited gas is below 0.08; otherwise add at most 0.04 gas capped at 0.28; leave coast, steer and brake rules unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one repaired original-student failure, no lost success on 1:5021, at least 20 vetoes, at least 100 bounded boosts, zero invalid actions.
control: Original frozen coast student on exactly the same four already consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: No repair, lost original success, insufficient intervention counts or invalid action.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on four consumed TRAIN cells, eight total episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local diagnostic, 900 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no reserved split or external action.
